speaker_title: Address by Dr. Lotay Tshering, MBBS, MD, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Bhutan

paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President

paragraphs.text: I would like to present warm greetings of His Majesty The King, Her Majesty The Queen and the people of Bhutan, from the land of Gross National Happiness.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to present warm greetings of His Majesty The King, Her Majesty 
The Queen and the people of Bhutan, from the land of Gross National Happiness.

paragraphs.text: To begin with, we express our solidarity with the international community as we cope with COVID-19. We offer prayers for lives lost to the pandemic and we wish strength to their loved ones.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To begin with, we express our solidarity with the international community as 
we cope with COVID-19. We offer prayers for lives lost to the pandemic and we wish 
strength to their loved ones.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President, I would like to congratulate you on your election as the President of the 75th Session of the General Assembly. I assure you my delegation’s full support in the discharge of your important responsibilities. I also commend your predecessor’s exemplary leadership in steering the 74th Session of the General Assembly.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Mr. President, I would like to congratulate you on your election as the 
President of the 75th Session of the General Assembly. I assure you my delegation’s 
full support in the discharge of your important responsibilities. I also commend 
your predecessor’s exemplary leadership in steering the 74th Session of the General 
Assembly.

paragraphs.text: COVID-19 and Bhutan’s unique story
paragraphs.raw_text: COVID-19 and Bhutan’s unique story

paragraphs.text: Like never before, at least in our lifetime, we are witnessing a pandemic that has heavy bearings on our lives and livelihoods.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Like never before, at least in our lifetime, we are witnessing a pandemic that 
has heavy bearings on our lives and livelihoods.

paragraphs.text: But, it is comforting that the UNGA is happening around this time. It provides us a platform to share and learn from each other in these extraordinary times. And I know all nations represented here are always ready to lend their ears on matters of global concern.
paragraphs.raw_text:
But, it is comforting that the UNGA is happening around this time. It provides 
us a platform to share and learn from each other in these extraordinary times. And 
I know all nations represented here are always ready to lend their ears on matters of 
global concern.

paragraphs.text: We are tackling COVID-19 as a single global community. We came this far sharing knowledge, information, experiences and evidences on the disease. I thank you all for the support. Bhutan has learned a lot in this exercise.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are tackling COVID-19 as a single global community. We came this far 
sharing knowledge, information, experiences and evidences on the disease. I thank 
you all for the support. Bhutan has learned a lot in this exercise.

paragraphs.text: And today, I seek your attention as I share the COVID-19 story of our small Himalayan Kingdom. This story revolves around a compassionate, wise and an astute 21st century King. A King we view with divine reverence and yet is so learned about every modern detail.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And today, I seek your attention as I share the COVID-19 story of our small 
Himalayan Kingdom. This story revolves around a compassionate, wise and an astute 
21st century King. A King we view with divine reverence and yet is so learned about 
every modern detail.

paragraphs.text: His Majesty The King has always been the symbol that held Bhutan together in its purpose and pursuits. It was always his Royal priority to protect the people of Bhutan at all times.
paragraphs.raw_text:
His Majesty The King has always been the symbol that held Bhutan together 
in its purpose and pursuits. It was always his Royal priority to protect the people of 
Bhutan at all times.

paragraphs.text: And in this pandemic, our King spearheads the battle to guard the country from the virus, making sure all Bhutanese, home and abroad, are safe and their spirits uplifted.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And in this pandemic, our King spearheads the battle to guard the country 
from the virus, making sure all Bhutanese, home and abroad, are safe and their spirits 
uplifted.

paragraphs.text: And then, we have Her Majesty The Queen, so passionately complementing all of His Majesty’s efforts.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And then, we have Her Majesty The Queen, so passionately complementing all 
of His Majesty’s efforts.

paragraphs.text: Under direct supervision of our King, we have meticulous surveillance systems in place. Which includes close monitoring of our international entry points and timely institution of 21 days quarantine, which is mandatory for everyone entering Bhutan
paragraphs.raw_text:
Under direct supervision of our King, we have meticulous surveillance systems 
in place. Which includes close monitoring of our international entry points and timely 
institution of 21 days quarantine, which is mandatory for everyone entering Bhutan

paragraphs.text: and fully sponsored by the government. Reliable and free testing facilities are also set up across the country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
and fully sponsored by the government. Reliable and free testing facilities are also 
set up across the country.

paragraphs.text: We have a professional health minister leading the team to execute every detail of the royal guidance. All these are being ensured without any compromise on routine health services like vaccination, MCH and NCD packages. And as I share this with much sense of achievement on this forum. I cannot help but thank all our frontline workers.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have a professional health minister leading the team to execute every 
detail of the royal guidance. All these are being ensured without any compromise 
on routine health services like vaccination, MCH and NCD packages. And as I share 
this with much sense of achievement on this forum. I cannot help but thank all our 
frontline workers.

paragraphs.text: Reciprocating the royal initiatives, all Bhutanese have gladly embraced the new practices of wearing face masks, maintaining physical distance, hand washing and avoiding unnecessary crowding to complement the efforts of the government. I am very grateful to the Bhutanese people for their support.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Reciprocating the royal initiatives, all Bhutanese have gladly embraced the 
new practices of wearing face masks, maintaining physical distance, hand washing 
and avoiding unnecessary crowding to complement the efforts of the government. I 
am very grateful to the Bhutanese people for their support.

paragraphs.text: It is through this act of unity that we managed to keep the number of cases low. As of today, we recorded 261 positive cases, of which 192 have recovered. Mortality from COVID-19 remains zero.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is through this act of unity that we managed to keep the number of cases low. 
As of today, we recorded 261 positive cases, of which 192 have recovered. Mortality 
from COVID-19 remains zero.

paragraphs.text: On all occasions, His Majesty expresses appreciation to the people for their hard work and solidarity. And in turn, people have their hearts filled with gratitude and devotion for our King. This unconditional unity under His Majesty’s leadership is the most distinct winning factor in our fight against COVID-19.
paragraphs.raw_text:
On all occasions, His Majesty expresses appreciation to the people for their 
hard work and solidarity. And in turn, people have their hearts filled with gratitude 
and devotion for our King. This unconditional unity under His Majesty’s leadership 
is the most distinct winning factor in our fight against COVID-19.

paragraphs.text: COVID-19 and GNH
paragraphs.raw_text: COVID-19 and GNH

paragraphs.text: For anything to thrive, we need a fertile ground. For Bhutan, to display innate qualities of harmony, we have the ambience of Gross National Happiness. It builds around the intrinsic values of interdependence, humanity and compassion.
paragraphs.raw_text:
For anything to thrive, we need a fertile ground. For Bhutan, to display innate 
qualities of harmony, we have the ambience of Gross National Happiness. It builds 
around the intrinsic values of interdependence, humanity and compassion.

paragraphs.text: As a key component of GNH, our visionary monarchs emphasised on protection and preservation of our environment. We have the Constitutional mandate to ensure 60 percent forest cover at all times and to maintain ‘inter-generational equity’ of our natural resources.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a key component of GNH, our visionary monarchs emphasised on protection 
and preservation of our environment. We have the Constitutional mandate to ensure 
60 percent forest cover at all times and to maintain ‘inter-generational equity’ of our 
natural resources.

paragraphs.text: So today, when the world is dealing with issues of climate change, we are grateful for the wise decisions that kept Bhutan carbon negative.
paragraphs.raw_text:
So today, when the world is dealing with issues of climate change, we are 
grateful for the wise decisions that kept Bhutan carbon negative.

paragraphs.text: Similarly, our Constitution mandates free healthcare and education for all Bhutanese. Our monarchs have always insisted on strengthening the social sector saying it is an investment not an expenditure.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Similarly, our Constitution mandates free healthcare and education for all 
Bhutanese. Our monarchs have always insisted on strengthening the social sector 
saying it is an investment not an expenditure.

paragraphs.text: Despite being a resource constrained country, access to these sectors is not an issue for the Bhutanese people. Which is why our existing public healthcare system needed only minimum adjustment to cope with the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Despite being a resource constrained country, access to these sectors is not an 
issue for the Bhutanese people. Which is why our existing public healthcare system 
needed only minimum adjustment to cope with the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: I personally feel this pandemic brought out the very essence of GNH, which seeks wellbeing of the people, not just of oneself but everyone around us. This disease, being highly contagious, requires us to act responsibly, so that our actions don’t compromise the safety of those who are more vulnerable.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I personally feel this pandemic brought out the very essence of GNH, which 
seeks wellbeing of the people, not just of oneself but everyone around us. This 
disease, being highly contagious, requires us to act responsibly, so that our actions 
don’t compromise the safety of those who are more vulnerable.

paragraphs.text: Understanding the pathophysiology of COVID-19, as a medical person, I am convinced that until we have effective vaccine the combination of professionally designed and well implemented physical distancing (which in extreme sense is called lockdown), and easily accessible and reliable testing is the best approach.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Understanding the pathophysiology of COVID-19, as a medical person, I am 
convinced that until we have effective vaccine the combination of professionally 
designed and well implemented physical distancing (which in extreme sense is called 
lockdown), and easily accessible and reliable testing is the best approach.

paragraphs.text: Our lockdown template elaborates three phases that adds up to three weeks, followed by 10 days of gradual unlocking phases. Bhutan experienced our first
paragraphs.raw_text:
Our lockdown template elaborates three phases that adds up to three weeks, 
followed by 10 days of gradual unlocking phases. Bhutan experienced our first

paragraphs.text: lockdown last month. To break the chain of transmission, people cooperated by staying home all through, allowing front-liners to do their jobs day in and out. (COVID-19 and social, economic interventions)
paragraphs.raw_text:
lockdown last month. To break the chain of transmission, people cooperated by 
staying home all through, allowing front-liners to do their jobs day in and out. 
(COVID-19 and social, economic interventions)

paragraphs.text: Even before COVID-19 was declared a pandemic, His Majesty expressed concerns that Bhutan will not be spared by this outbreak. He reminded us that if we are not strategic, the health crisis could easily lead to economic problems and subsequently to social crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Even before COVID-19 was declared a pandemic, His Majesty expressed 
concerns that Bhutan will not be spared by this outbreak. He reminded us that if 
we are not strategic, the health crisis could easily lead to economic problems and 
subsequently to social crisis.

paragraphs.text: Which is why, all interventions to look after the livelihood of the people , are designed within the magnanimity of our King. The conventional fiscal and monetary measures attend to the affected entities and individuals. Special teams are formed to look after both informal and formal sectors.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Which is why, all interventions to look after the livelihood of the people , are 
designed within the magnanimity of our King. The conventional fiscal and monetary 
measures attend to the affected entities and individuals. Special teams are formed to 
look after both informal and formal sectors.

paragraphs.text: However, His Majesty’s biggest concern is for those who could fall into the cracks within the system, which happens particularly in times of crisis. Thus, the King’s Relief Fund ensures no one is left behind.
paragraphs.raw_text:
However, His Majesty’s biggest concern is for those who could fall into the 
cracks within the system, which happens particularly in times of crisis. Thus, the 
King’s Relief Fund ensures no one is left behind.

paragraphs.text: The royal intervention goes to the extent of taking care of the interest payment on all loans of the citizens for a year. A special package is designed for the elderly and people with co-morbid medical conditions. Besides other social supports, essentials are delivered at their doorsteps. This unique feature is designed particularly to protect the most vulnerable group.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The royal intervention goes to the extent of taking care of the interest payment 
on all loans of the citizens for a year. A special package is designed for the elderly and 
people with co-morbid medical conditions. Besides other social supports, essentials 
are delivered at their doorsteps. This unique feature is designed particularly to protect 
the most vulnerable group.

paragraphs.text: His Majesty has always commanded that we should not lose even a single person to the disease. Hopefully, with all these interventions, we will be able to live up to our King’s expectations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
His Majesty has always commanded that we should not lose even a single 
person to the disease. Hopefully, with all these interventions, we will be able to live 
up to our King’s expectations.

paragraphs.text: 75th Anniversary of the UN
paragraphs.raw_text: 75th Anniversary of the UN

paragraphs.text: We all know UN has come a long way and achieved major milestones. When the UN celebrated the 25th anniversary, it was on the theme of Peace, Justice and Progress. Despite challenges, we have seen so much improvement in these areas.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We all know UN has come a long way and achieved major milestones. When 
the UN celebrated the 25th anniversary, it was on the theme of Peace, Justice and 
Progress. Despite challenges, we have seen so much improvement in these areas.

paragraphs.text: Twenty-five years later, on its 50th anniversary, it committed to the theme of poverty eradication. Had it not been for the pandemic, we were well on track.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Twenty-five years later, on its 50th anniversary, it committed to the theme of 
poverty eradication. Had it not been for the pandemic, we were well on track.

paragraphs.text: And the theme for the 75th anniversary on “multilateralism” cannot be more relevant. Like climate change, COVID-19 also knows no borders, and similarly affects developing countries disproportionately.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And the theme for the 75th anniversary on “multilateralism” cannot be more 
relevant. Like climate change, COVID-19 also knows no borders, and similarly 
affects developing countries disproportionately.

paragraphs.text: We do not know what is coming next. We also do not know when SARS- CoV-3 will hit us. In that sense, are we not interconnected? Is there a second option to multilateralism? These are questions we must keep asking ourselves frequently peaceful coexistence among ourselves and with the nature around us is the best vaccine for humanity to thrive on this planet.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We do not know what is coming next. We also do not know when SARS-
CoV-3 will hit us. In that sense, are we not interconnected? Is there a second option 
to multilateralism? These are questions we must keep asking ourselves frequently 
peaceful coexistence among ourselves and with the nature around us is the best 
vaccine for humanity to thrive on this planet.

paragraphs.text: In this small, intricate world, while fighting a highly infectious disease, it will be a big blunder if we do not help the developing world to have access to all the critical resources including vaccine when it actually becomes available.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this small, intricate world, while fighting a highly infectious disease, it 
will be a big blunder if we do not help the developing world to have access to all the 
critical resources including vaccine when it actually becomes available.

paragraphs.text: I emphasize on the global message of no one being safe until all of us are safe. This is so true that for a highly contagious disease, you can never be safe until everyone else is safe.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I emphasize on the global message of no one being safe until all of us are 
safe. This is so true that for a highly contagious disease, you can never be safe until 
everyone else is safe.

paragraphs.text: 2030 Agenda of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
paragraphs.raw_text: 2030 Agenda of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)

paragraphs.text: Now let me touch a bit on the SDGs, the universal goals for our sustainable future.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Now let me touch a bit on the SDGs, the universal goals for our 

sustainable future.

paragraphs.text: For us, the SDGs resonate well with our developmental plans based on the principles of GNH. For the same reason, Bhutan was on track to become an early achiever of the SDGs, as shown by the voluntary review in 2018.
paragraphs.raw_text:
For us, the SDGs resonate well with our developmental plans based on the 
principles of GNH. For the same reason, Bhutan was on track to become an early 
achiever of the SDGs, as shown by the voluntary review in 2018.

paragraphs.text: But these were the goals set before the pandemic. Our planning commission is closely studying the impact of COVID-19 on our developmental plans. Even otherwise, trends around the world and back home offer evidence enough that we will now be falling short of the targets.
paragraphs.raw_text:
But these were the goals set before the pandemic. Our planning commission 
is closely studying the impact of COVID-19 on our developmental plans. Even 
otherwise, trends around the world and back home offer evidence enough that we 
will now be falling short of the targets.

paragraphs.text: All 17 SDGs are interconnected, and not a single sector will be spared by the consequences of this pandemic. Most obvious ones are the goals on health, education and our economy.
paragraphs.raw_text:
All 17 SDGs are interconnected, and not a single sector will be spared by the 
consequences of this pandemic. Most obvious ones are the goals on health, education 
and our economy.

paragraphs.text: If individuals or agencies or even governments are re-aligning with the realities of COVID-19, shouldn’t we revisit SDGs too? I feel it is time to field a special team to work on a new framework of SDGs, which should encapsulate all elements that will help us walk the path of new normal with more prudence.
paragraphs.raw_text:
If individuals or agencies or even governments are re-aligning with the realities 
of COVID-19, shouldn’t we revisit SDGs too? I feel it is time to field a special team to 
work on a new framework of SDGs, which should encapsulate all elements that will 
help us walk the path of new normal with more prudence.

paragraphs.text: LDC graduation
paragraphs.raw_text: LDC graduation

paragraphs.text: Just as we see the need to review the whole SDGs, this pandemic has also derailed us off the LDC graduation track. Our current plan was designed to help Bhutan graduate from LDC category in 2023. Now everything has changed, as our focus has shifted to saving lives and livelihoods from the challenges posed by this pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Just as we see the need to review the whole SDGs, this pandemic has also 
derailed us off the LDC graduation track. Our current plan was designed to help 
Bhutan graduate from LDC category in 2023. Now everything has changed, as our 
focus has shifted to saving lives and livelihoods from the challenges posed by this 
pandemic.

paragraphs.text: We know millions are pushed back into poverty, and more lost their jobs. We would have gone back by decades. Bringing our developmental achievements back on track will not be easy. And for some developing countries, it will be almost irreversible.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We know millions are pushed back into poverty, and more lost their jobs. 
We would have gone back by decades. Bringing our developmental achievements 
back on track will not be easy. And for some developing countries, it will be almost 
irreversible.

paragraphs.text: Therefore, I would like to request the UN to reset this global developmental path and help us regain our grip for smooth transition from the LDC category.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Therefore, I would like to request the UN to reset this global developmental 
path and help us regain our grip for smooth transition from the LDC category.

paragraphs.text: UN Reform and Peacekeeping
paragraphs.raw_text: UN Reform and Peacekeeping

paragraphs.text: Mr. President, at a time when the relevance of multilateralism is often questioned, Bhutan’s faith in the Organisation remains unwavering and firm. The challenges we face as a global community are numerous and multifaceted for individual states to tackle on its own. From our perspective, there is no alternative but to work together.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Mr. President, at a time when the relevance of multilateralism is often 
questioned, Bhutan’s faith in the Organisation remains unwavering and firm. The 
challenges we face as a global community are numerous and multifaceted for 
individual states to tackle on its own. From our perspective, there is no alternative 
but to work together.

paragraphs.text: At the same time, the UN must also evolve and match the changing realities. In particular, the existing structure and composition of the UN Security Council do not reflect the current realities and circumstances of the world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At the same time, the UN must also evolve and match the changing realities. 
In particular, the existing structure and composition of the UN Security Council do 
not reflect the current realities and circumstances of the world.

paragraphs.text: Bhutan has also long supported the aspirations of the G4 to serve as Permanent Members to an expanded Security Council, of course, with Africa also appropriately represented.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Bhutan has also long supported the aspirations of the G4 to serve as 
Permanent Members to an expanded Security Council, of course, with Africa also 

appropriately represented.

paragraphs.text: As a peaceful country, we have enjoyed the benefits of the UN membership for almost five decades. We joined the fraternity of troop and police-contributing countries in the year 2014. Since then, our engagements in peacekeeping operations have gradually increased. We stand ready to be deployed at all times. (Conclusion)
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a peaceful country, we have enjoyed the benefits of the UN membership 
for almost five decades. We joined the fraternity of troop and police-contributing 
countries in the year 2014. Since then, our engagements in peacekeeping operations 
have gradually increased. We stand ready to be deployed at all times. (Conclusion)

paragraphs.text: Excellencies, ladies and gentlemen, with health and education being the priority of this government, may I remind you that last year I shared with you all, the gratifying news of making our teachers the highest paid civil servants in my country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Excellencies, ladies and gentlemen, with health and education being the 
priority of this government, may I remind you that last year I shared with you all, the 
gratifying news of making our teachers the highest paid civil servants in my country.

paragraphs.text: With such historic initiatives, my government was excited to redefine our education system that was not just about school enrollment and conventional teaching. We were going all out to engage our children in learning process that is meaningful, and built around relevant skills and innovation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
With such historic initiatives, my government was excited to redefine our 
education system that was not just about school enrollment and conventional teaching. 
We were going all out to engage our children in learning process that is meaningful, 
and built around relevant skills and innovation.

paragraphs.text: But it is disappointing when we have to opt for online and distant learning due to circumstances. This robs our young minds of opportunities to play and eat together with peers and teachers on the same campus.
paragraphs.raw_text:
But it is disappointing when we have to opt for online and distant learning due 
to circumstances. This robs our young minds of opportunities to play and eat together 
with peers and teachers on the same campus.

paragraphs.text: In the process, they are deprived of all the values of human connection, which we all know, have huge psycho-social impact. We may not realize it today but will have to bear the brunt down the line. It could impact an entire generation of our children if we are not mindful of that today.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In the process, they are deprived of all the values of human connection, which 
we all know, have huge psycho-social impact. We may not realize it today but will 
have to bear the brunt down the line. It could impact an entire generation of our 
children if we are not mindful of that today.

paragraphs.text: The COVID-19 has revealed a stark fact that our investments in these social sectors are far and lacking. No one can be sure when SARS-CoV-3 might trigger another pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The COVID-19 has revealed a stark fact that our investments in these social 
sectors are far and lacking. No one can be sure when SARS-CoV-3 might trigger 
another pandemic.

paragraphs.text: Therefore, we must redesign our developmental path and double up our investment in these social sectors. Going forward, relevantly educated and healthy global citizens will have to be at the heart of the new normal.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Therefore, we must redesign our developmental path and double up our 
investment in these social sectors. Going forward, relevantly educated and healthy 
global citizens will have to be at the heart of the new normal.

paragraphs.text: If we all are convinced that spending more on health and education is an investment and not an expenditure, if we live by this commitment it would be a different ball game hereafter.
paragraphs.raw_text:
If we all are convinced that spending more on health and education is an 
investment and not an expenditure, if we live by this commitment it would be a 
different ball game hereafter.

paragraphs.text: That way, when we celebrate UN’s next milestone, the 100th anniversary, we would have achieved 100 per cent literacy rate, which empowers everyone with relevant skills and knowledge for a meaningful life.
paragraphs.raw_text:
That way, when we celebrate UN’s next milestone, the 100th anniversary, 
we would have achieved 100 per cent literacy rate, which empowers everyone with 
relevant skills and knowledge for a meaningful life.

paragraphs.text: This would also enable everyone to be 100 per cent digitally competent to help them derive advantages of technology from all corners of the world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This would also enable everyone to be 100 per cent digitally competent to help 
them derive advantages of technology from all corners of the world.

paragraphs.text: And as a medical practitioner, it would be wish fulfilling if our health system improves so much that our life expectancy touches 100 years when UN turns a century in 2045.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And as a medical practitioner, it would be wish fulfilling if our health system 
improves so much that our life expectancy touches 100 years when UN turns a 
century in 2045.

paragraphs.text: Finally, in wishing the 75th session of the UNGA every success, we send prayers for good health and happiness of every living being on this planet.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Finally, in wishing the 75th session of the UNGA every success, we send 
prayers for good health and happiness of every living being on this planet.

paragraphs.text: Thank you and Tashi Delek!
paragraphs.raw_text: Thank you and Tashi Delek!
